evidence.summary: TRANQUILITY Missed Primary Endpoint, but Schirmer Test Secondary Endpoint Achieved (p=0.0001) and Represents an Approvable Sign

evidence.safety: Topical ocular reproxalap has been studied in more than 1,500 patients with no observed safety concerns; mild and transient instillation site discomfort is the most commonly reported adverse event in clinical trials.
